actions.desc: Enters special rage that lets it channel elemental power for 1 min. While ragecasting: disadvantage on Wis saves and gains fly speed of 60'. It can end ragecasting as a bonus action. When ragecasting ends it descends 60'/round until it lands on a solid surface and can continue concentrating on spell it cast while ragecasting.
